text: {"bodies": ["Just between us, a few people are starting to wonder if Mikko Nieminen (e07) might have something to do with these recent document leaks. Obviously it is pure speculation at this point, just some quiet chatter going around the floor.", "Honestly, it would not shock me one bit if Tuomas Makinen (e17) is the one sharing confidential files outside the company.
